He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's Hawks]]. He was drafted by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in the second round of the [[2025 NBA draft]] and subsequently traded to the Suns. ==High school career== Fleming attended [[Gloucester City High School]] in [[Gloucester City, New Jersey]] for his freshman and sophomore years of high school before transferring to [[Camden High School (New Jersey)|Camden High School]] in [[Camden, New Jersey]]. He grew three inches between his sophomore and junior years.{{cite signs letter of intent to play basketball at St. Joseph's|first=Josh|last=Friedman|work=[[Courier-Post]]|date=November 15, 2021|access-date=December 5, 2024}} ==College career== Fleming averaged 5.8 points and five rebounds per game during his freshman season with the [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's Hawks]] in 2022–23.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/st-joes/rasheer-fleming-saint-josephs-basketball-mens-a10-tournament-20240315.html|title=St. Joe’s sophomore forward Rasheer Fleming’s rise is fueling a trip to the A-10 semifinal|first=Lochlahn|last=March|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=March 15, 2024|access-date=October 18, 2024}} He became the Hawks' starting power forward midway through his freshman year.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/big-5-classic-sju-temple-championship-20231202.html|title=Big 5 Classic: The path to an ‘appointed and anointed time’ for St. Joe’s featured a big night from Rasheer Fleming|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=December 2, 2023|access-date=October 29, 2024}} Fleming finished his sophomore season averaging 10.7 points per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-saint-joseph-rasheer-fleming-versatility-power-five|title=NBA Draft: Saint Joseph's Rasheer Fleming Has Shown Impressive Versatility Against Three Power Five Opponents|first=Jace|last=Derryberry|website=[[SI.com]]|date=November 24, 2024|access-date=December 5, 2024}} During his junior season, he scored 19 points in a win over rival [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]].{{cite web|url=https://www.delcotimes.com/2024/11/12/rasheer-fleming-scores-19-points-to-lead-saint-josephs-past-villanova/|title=Rasheer Fleming scores 19 points to lead Saint Joseph’s past Villanova|work=[[Delaware County Daily Times]]|date=November 12, 2024}} He was named First Team All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] after averaging 14.7 points, 8.5 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game. In April 2025, Fleming declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=Saint Joseph's F Fleming will enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44630650/saint-joseph-forward-rasheer-fleming-enter-nba-draft |access-date=June 27, 2025 |work=ESPN.com |date=April 11, 2025 |language=en}} ==Professional career== Fleming was selected by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] with the 31st overall pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]] and subsequently traded to the [[Phoenix Suns]] on July 6 in a seven-team trade.{{cite news |title=PHOENIX SUNS ACQUIRE DILLON BROOKS, JALEN GREEN AND DRAFT RIGHTS TO KHAMAN MALUACH, RASHEER FLEMING AND KOBY BREA IN SEVEN-TEAM TRADE |url=https://www.nba.com/suns/news/phoenix-suns-acquire-dillon-brooks-jalen-green-and-draft-rights-to-khaman-maluach-rasheer-fleming-and-koby-brea-in-seven-team-trade |access-date=July 6, 2025 |work=NBA.com |date=July 6, 2025}}{{cite news |title=76ers draft Broome, Suns land Fleming in Round 2 |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/45593263/rasheer-fleming-goes-suns-no-31-2025-nba-draft-resumes |access-date=June 27, 2025 |work=ESPN.com |date=June 27, 2025 |language=en}} On December 4, he was assigned to the Suns' G League affiliate, the [[Valley Suns]].{{cite web |title=Suns' Rasheer Fleming: Assigned to G League |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/suns-rasheer-fleming-assigned-to-g-league-506981/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |access-date=December 13, 2025 |date=December 4, 2025}} Fleming was recalled to Phoenix on December 12.{{cite web |title=Suns' Rasheer Fleming: Back to NBA |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/suns-rasheer-fleming-back-to-nba/ |website=[[CBS Sports]]
